description: Ask a question across about 490 curated 2026 conference talks and get a generated answer whose citations give each talk's video URL (with t=) and start_seconds, plus its conference, year and speakers. Optional filters: conference (one of ai-engineer-worlds-fair, ai-engineer-europe, kubecon-eu, google-cloud-next, microsoft-build, pycon-us, google-io, code-with-claude, openai-devday), year, and speaker (part of a name, case-insensitive; speakers are known for about half the talks, so a speaker filter misses the rest). A filter that matches no talk answers `answer: null` and costs nothing. Maps to POST /v1/search/talks. Charged: $0.02 flat per call by default, or free within the daily free allowance. With an API key it needs the key's `query` scope. Without an API key this tool is payable in USDC via x402: the first call returns a payment-required result (`isError` with the payment requirements in `structuredContent`); an x402-aware MCP client signs and retries the same call with `_meta['x402/payment']`, and the receipt returns in the result's `_meta['x402/payment-response']`. Never pay again after a 409 (already presented) or 502 (settlement unknown) result. Prices are the service defaults; `quote` returns the exact price.
